description: 覆盖批量命令边界：空集合、非法 token、重复去重、超上限与退役序号失败回包。

phases.name: crosschunk_whitelist_set_deduped
phases.commandTemplate: redstonelink crosschunk whitelist set target core {{targets[0]}}/{{targets[0]}}/{{targets[1]}} resident confirm
expectedRegexes: (?i)(Duplicate serials were deduplicated|检测到重复序号)

phases.name: crosschunk_whitelist_set_empty_should_fail
phases.command: redstonelink crosschunk whitelist set target core / confirm
phases.expectedRegex: (?i)(Whitelist set input is empty|目标为空)

phases.name: crosschunk_whitelist_set_invalid_token_should_fail
phases.commandTemplate: redstonelink crosschunk whitelist set target core {{targets[0]}}/abc confirm

phases.name: crosschunk_whitelist_set_too_many_should_fail
phases.command: redstonelink crosschunk whitelist set target core 1:1025 confirm
phases.expectedRegex: (?i)(Too many whitelist set serials|max|数量过多|最多)

phases.name: node_alias_set_invalid_chars_should_fail
phases.commandTemplate: redstonelink node alias set core {{targets[0]}} 坏-1
phases.expectedRegex: (?i)(invalid|无效|只能包含中文、字母或数字)

phases.name: node_alias_set_core_first_success
phases.commandTemplate: redstonelink node alias set core {{targets[0]}} 边界1

phases.name: node_alias_set_conflict_same_type_should_fail
phases.commandTemplate: redstonelink node alias set core {{targets[1]}} 边界1

phases.name: retire_boundary_target
phases.commandTemplate: redstonelink node retire batch core {{targets[2]}} confirm

phases.name: crosschunk_whitelist_add_retired_should_fail
phases.commandTemplate: redstonelink crosschunk whitelist add target core {{targets[2]}}

phases.name: node_alias_set_retired_target_should_fail
phases.commandTemplate: redstonelink node alias set core {{targets[2]}} 退役1
